title: ACTIVATE
goal: Spark curiosity about Confetti Cake Cottage School and introduce the Zenix approach to solving mysteries through careful observation, thoughtful questions, and understanding different perspectives.
outcomes: Ask thoughtful questions about the school and its mysteries.
Identify an unusual detail about Callie Cupcake.
Explain why Zenix gather information and consider different perspectives before judging.
focus: Encourage students to seek understanding before making judgments.

rows.text: Slides 1–3 — Introduce Chewlandia Academy and Confetti Cake Cottage School.
Slide 3 — Display during the welcome letter.
Slide 4 — Play Mrs. Tongsley's video transmission.
What are you wondering about after her message?
Slide 5 — Play the Bakery Log and Callie reveal video.
What unusual detail stood out about Callie?

Callie has been a mystery at Confetti Cake Cottage for years. A cupcake that seems to move on her own? That's enough to make anyone wonder!

But Chewlandia has mysteries bigger than a wandering cupcake. When friendships begin to crack and a celebration loses its sparkle, guessing won't put things right. Sometimes, the sweetest answer comes from listening first.

There's a name for those trusted to search carefully, one question at a time...
Slide 6 — Reveal the Zenix and their first rule.

Long before the villages of Chewlandia worked together, people believed every celebration was held together by an invisible ingredient. Without it, even the finest recipes fell flat.

Those entrusted with finding it were called the Zenix. Their first rule was simple:

Never repair what you do not yet understand.
rows.bold_text: Never repair what you do not yet understand.

rows.text:
The Battle of the Bakers is only days away. Then... everything changes. One unexpected team switch leaves friendships strained and trust shaken.

As Chewlandia's newest Zenix, your first assignment isn't to decide who was right or wrong. Gather clues, explore every perspective, and uncover the missing ingredient behind The Bake-Off Betrayal.

Mission: Restore the Sparkle.
Why does the Zenix rule matter when people disagree?

bonuses.description: — Create a school identity and collect quest badges; add 10–20 minutes.
